verdict.rationale: Xero's JAX AI tool and bank feed docs explicitly describe automatic transaction import, categorization, and matching suggestions during reconciliation (xero-docs-20, xero-docs-27), which is the core of the story. However, evidence does not explicitly confirm the system learns from user corrections over time, only that it categorizes and matches; missing for 10: explicit documentation of a learning/feedback loop from corrections, independent user testimony confirming categorization accuracy improves over time.
